010674c39578.name: 5: Mark of the Incomparable Hunter
010674c39578.plain: Each time this Warlord makes a ranged attack, add 1 to that attack's Strength characteristic. For those attacks, an unmodified wound roll of 6 also deals 1 mortal wound to the target, on top of any normal damage.

01b7e8b1eb4b.name: Stimulant Innovators
01b7e8b1eb4b.plain: Once per battle, in your Command phase, you can roll one D3 on the Combat Drugs table and give the result to units with this Obsession until the turn ends. Only units that have the Combat Drugs ability get it, and it stacks with any abilities they already have.

061a9b823564.name: The Djin Blade
061a9b823564.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it gets 2 extra attacks with this weapon. If it attacked with this weapon at all, roll one D6 at the end of the Fight phase: on a 1, the bearer suffers 1 mortal wound.

085bcfe3822f.name: The Weeping Stones
085bcfe3822f.plain: While the bearer is on the battlefield, you can roll one extra D6 whenever you make a Strand of Fate roll. Only an ASURYANI PSYKER can have this Relic.

waive.143: page number reference ("pg 143") to where the Strand of Fate rule is printed; the style guide forbids page references

08cfb17d8f3c.name: Elite Citizenry
08cfb17d8f3c.plain: Models with this attribute add 1 to their Leadership characteristic, and when a unit with this attribute fights, you can re-roll one of its hit rolls.

0ac5df67b1d6.name: A Foot in the Future
0ac5df67b1d6.plain: You can add 6 to this Warlord's charge rolls, and when it Advances, add D3+3" to its Move characteristic until the end of the phase instead of an Advance roll.

0c16c98dd294.name: Soulheim
0c16c98dd294.plain:
The bearer gains these abilities:
- Subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack that targets the bearer.
- Roll one D6 each time the bearer would lose a wound: on a 5+, that wound isn't lost.

0c2bdf30ce10.name: Spirit-Sting
0c2bdf30ce10.plain: This weapon has Poisoned Weapon (2+), and invulnerable saves can't be taken against its attacks.

0ee496278fc1.name: Kabal of the Black Heart: Thirst for Power
0ee496278fc1.plain:
When working out Power From Pain effects for units with this Obsession that have that ability, count the battle round as one higher than it really is.
If a Realspace Raid Detachment contains a KABAL OF THE BLACK HEART ARCHON, then for the rest of the battle all BLADES FOR HIRE units in that Detachment with the Power From Pain ability get the same benefit.
Models with this Obsession add 1 to their Leadership characteristic.
When a unit with this Obsession shoots or fights, you can re-roll one of its hit rolls.

waive.89: page number reference ("pg 89") to where the Power From Pain ability is printed; the style guide forbids page references

119cd103d962.name: Crash and Burn
119cd103d962.plain: When this model is reduced to 0 wounds, roll one D6 before removing it: on a 6, it explodes, and every unit within 6" of it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

1326be86b787.name: The Phoenix Plume
1326be86b787.plain: The bearer gets a 4+ invulnerable save, and each time a model in its unit would lose a wound, roll one D6: the wound isn't lost on a 5+. Only a Swooping Hawk Exarch model can have this.

1330a335b317.name: Dark Technomancers (All-Consuming)
1330a335b317.plain: When a unit with this Obsession shoots, you can enhance any or all of its ranged weapons to add 1 to their attacks' wound rolls and Damage this phase. Liquifier guns and twin liquifier guns can never be enhanced. Hit rolls for attacks with an enhanced weapon can't be re-rolled. If any attack with an enhanced weapon has an unmodified hit roll of 1, the bearer's unit suffers 1 mortal wound once it has shot with that weapon; a VEHICLE or MONSTER bearer suffers D3 mortal wounds instead.

15e7224173ae.name: Crescendo
15e7224173ae.plain: Only a HARLEQUINS model with a shuriken pistol can take this Relic, which replaces that shuriken pistol and uses its own weapon profile.

1600085ac236.name: Player of the Dark
1600085ac236.plain: When this Warlord attacks in melee, each unmodified wound roll of 5+ also deals 1 mortal wound to the target, on top of any normal damage.

163dd81ed866.name: Seer Council (Warlocks)
163dd81ed866.plain:
Add 1 to Psychic tests for the selected FARSEER model while it is within 6" of this WARLOCKS unit.
While that FARSEER model is within 3" of this WARLOCKS unit, it can use the Look Out, Sir rule even when this unit has fewer than 3 models.

167af1aee3db.name: Kabal of the Obsidian Rose: Flawless Workmanship
167af1aee3db.plain:
Models with this Obsession add 6" to the Range characteristic of their Assault, Rapid Fire and Heavy weapons (Relics excluded).
When a unit with this Obsession shoots or fights, you can re-roll one of its wound rolls.

170759edb1b0.name: In The Footsteps Of The Ancients
170759edb1b0.plain:
Pick one of these craftworlds: Ulthwe, Alaitoc, Biel-Tan, Iyanden or Saim-Hann; units with this attribute use that craftworld's Craftworld Attribute.
This Far-Flung Craftworld Attribute can't be combined with any other Far-Flung Craftworld Attribute.
If a CHARACTER model with this attribute gets a Warlord Trait, it can have the Craftworld Warlord Trait of the craftworld you picked instead of a normal one. On such a Warlord Trait, replace every instance of the <CRAFTWORLD> keyword (for example IYANDEN), if there are any, with the name of the craftworld this CHARACTER model comes from.
Unless every unit with this attribute is in an Auxiliary Support, Super-heavy Auxiliary and/or Fortification Network Detachment, you also get the Craftworld Stratagem of the craftworld you picked. When you use it, replace every instance of the <CRAFTWORLD> keyword on it (for example IYANDEN) with the craftworld your units with this attribute have.

waive.85: page number reference ("pages 85-89") to where the Craftworld Attributes are printed; the style guide forbids page references
waive.89: page number reference ("pages 85-89") to where the Craftworld Attributes are printed; the style guide forbids page references
waive.119: page number reference ("page 119") to where the standard Warlord Traits are printed; the style guide forbids page references

18b0a40577b7.name: Disdain for Lesser Beings
18b0a40577b7.plain: Add 1 to Combat Attrition tests taken for units with this Obsession.

197e03e5b4a7.name: Fractal Storm
197e03e5b4a7.plain: Your opponent can't re-roll hit rolls, wound rolls or damage rolls for attacks made against this Warlord.

1984d7a0bb56.name: Shard of Anaris
1984d7a0bb56.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it gets D3+3 extra attacks with this weapon.

1a11c2f49fdc.name: Obsessive Collectors
1a11c2f49fdc.plain: Whenever a melee attack by a unit with this Obsession destroys an enemy unit, one model in the attacking unit can regain D3 lost wounds. No model can be healed more than once per turn. If the attacker is a WRACK unit, D3 of its destroyed models can be added back to it. Those models can only be placed within Engagement Range of those enemy units already in Engagement Range of this unit, and they no longer count as destroyed for Morale tests this turn.

1ad641b20308.name: Students of Vaul
1ad641b20308.plain: Add 1 to armour saving throws made for a VEHICLE model with this attribute against attacks with a Damage characteristic of 1.

1b5ecd577d7e.name: Luck of the Laughing God
1b5ecd577d7e.plain: The battle-size table in the Luck of the Laughing God ability no longer applies. At the start of the battle round you get 0 Luck re-rolls, whatever the battle size: the only way to gain Luck re-rolls is to make a Luck of the Laughing God roll.

1ba183f8627f.name: The Storied Sword
1ba183f8627f.plain: Only a HARLEQUINS model with an Aeldari power sword can take this Relic, which replaces that Aeldari power sword and uses its own weapon profile.

1c7bdeececef.name: The Glaive Exquisite
1c7bdeececef.plain: Add 1 to the wound roll for attacks with this weapon that target an enemy unit with a Leadership characteristic of 8 or more. If the bearer fought with this weapon in a phase but didn't target any such enemy unit, it suffers 1 mortal wound at the end of that phase.

1dd5ceb4729b.name: The Twilight Fang
1dd5ceb4729b.plain: Only a TWILIGHT TROUPE MASTER model with an Aeldari power sword can take this Relic, which replaces that sword and uses its own weapon profile.

waive.TWIGHLIGHT TROUPE MASTER: typo in the official text for TWILIGHT TROUPE MASTER; the plain text uses the correctly spelled TWILIGHT TROUPE MASTER keyword

1f74707af8de.name: Children of Prophecy
1f74707af8de.plain: When a PSYKER unit with this attribute takes a Psychic test or Deny the Witch test, you can re-roll any or all of its dice that show a 1 or 2.

1fdf5f7b495b.name: Master of Death
1fdf5f7b495b.plain: Each unmodified hit roll of 6 for this Warlord's melee weapon attacks scores 1 extra hit.

2075bec7eac9.name: Poisoner's Ampule
2075bec7eac9.plain:
Once per battle, at the end of your Movement phase, pick one enemy unit within 9" of the bearer:
- roll one D6, and on a 2+ it suffers D3 mortal wounds.
- the unit's own Aura abilities stop working until the start of your next turn.
- until the start of your next turn, the unit can't be affected by Aura abilities of friendly models.

210c43f77bf4.name: The Flensing Blade
210c43f77bf4.plain: This weapon has Poisoned Weapon (2+), and its attacks against a CHARACTER unit have a Damage characteristic of 3.

21c2e776e6ed.name: 3. Artist of Dark Alchemy
21c2e776e6ed.plain: Once per turn, you can re-roll a number-of-attacks roll for a weapon of a friendly <HAEMONCULUS COVEN> CORE model, if its unit is within 6" of this WARLORD. If you do, then for the rest of the phase you can also re-roll every number-of-attacks roll for weapons used by models in that unit.

21ede7160bdc.name: The Prophets of Flesh: Connoisseurs of Pain
21ede7160bdc.plain:
At the start of your Command phase, every CHARACTER, GROTESQUES OR MONSTER unit that has this Obsession regains 1 lost wound.
When an attack is made against a unit with this Obsession, unless the attack's Strength characteristic is 8 or more, an unmodified wound roll of 1-3 for it fails, whatever abilities the attacking weapon or model has.

229ad5909683.name: Towering Arrogance (Aura)
229ad5909683.plain: Aura: while one of your KABAL OF THE POISONED TONGUE units is within 6" of this WARLORD, you can ignore any or all modifiers to its Combat Attrition tests.

24561f7a00e1.name: Grave Lotus
24561f7a00e1.plain: Models in this unit have their Strength characteristic increased by 1.

24bf82852c9d.name: Superior Shurikens
24bf82852c9d.plain: Shuriken weapons that models in units with this attribute are equipped with have their Range characteristic increased by 3".

waive.143: page number reference ("pg 143") to where shuriken weapons are defined; the style guide forbids page references

273c8ee2bf64.name: Enhanced Sensory Organs
273c8ee2bf64.plain: Targets of attacks made by models with this Obsession don't get the benefits of Light Cover or Heavy Cover against those attacks.

27ee2cf6b5a0.name: Ancient Evil
27ee2cf6b5a0.plain: At the start of the Fight phase, this WARLORD can hold back an enemy unit in its Engagement Range: it can't fight this phase until all your eligible units have.

289a87f8f338.name: Reckless Abandon [LEGENDS]
289a87f8f338.plain: This unit can make Heroic Interventions just as a CHARACTER could.

28a1f83f663a.name: Ulthwe: Foresight of the Damned
28a1f83f663a.plain:
When a unit with this attribute shoots or fights, you can re-roll one of its wound rolls.
Add 1 to the first Psychic test taken for each PSYKER unit with this attribute in each turn.
Models with this attribute get a 6+ invulnerable save.
Whenever a model with this attribute would lose a wound to a mortal wound, roll one D6; on a 5+ it isn't lost.

2903a20aac8c.name: Grim
2903a20aac8c.plain: Add 1 to Combat Attrition tests taken for units with this attribute.

298912cd0436.name: 6: Seer of the Shifting Vector
298912cd0436.plain: While this Warlord is on the battlefield, you can roll one D6 per Command point either player spends on a Stratagem: each 6 gains you 1 Command point.

2a9317d63d51.name: The Animus Vitae
2a9317d63d51.plain: Once per battle, the bearer can shoot this weapon: if it hits, the target suffers D3 mortal wounds (D3+3 instead if the target unit has 11 or more models). Until the end of the turn, your units with the Power from Pain ability count the battle round as one higher than it really is when working out which of its effects they get.

2bfe46b5254e.name: The Coven of Twelve: Butchers of Flesh
2bfe46b5254e.plain:
Attacks made by models with this Obsession with melee weapons other than Relics have their Armour Penetration characteristic improved by 1.
A unit with this Obsession that is performing an action can still make ranged attacks without the action failing.

2c98d438275d.name: Twilight: Twilight Falls
2c98d438275d.plain:
Models in a unit with this characterisation fight with 1 extra attack if the unit charged, was charged or performed a Heroic Intervention this turn. The bonus lasts until that fight is resolved.
Models with this characterisation can move up to 2" further when they pile in or consolidate.

2f355bfd4cd5.name: Alaitoc: Master of Ambush
2f355bfd4cd5.plain:
In your Command phase, you can pick one ALAITOC INFANTRY CORE unit within 9" of this Warlord: this turn, it can shoot mid-action without the action failing.
When the first battle round starts, before the first turn, if this Warlord is on the battlefield, you can pick one other friendly ALAITOC RANGERS unit on the battlefield. Remove it and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from the enemy deployment zone and from all enemy models. If both players have redeploy abilities that work before the first turn, roll off; the winner picks which player redeploys their units first.

30c68f05f7c8.name: Stratagem: Wealth and Power
30c68f05f7c8.plain: Until the end of the battle, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of every ranged attack made by this unit.

312484e42684.name: Twilight Gloom
312484e42684.plain: Warp charge 6: if manifested, pick one of your WRAITH HOST units within 18" of the psyker to get the cover bonus to its saves until your next turn starts. It gets this bonus even when it isn't wholly on or within a terrain feature.

319bc2a0512e.name: The Spider's Bite
319bc2a0512e.plain: Only a Warp Spider Exarch model with powerblades can take this Relic, which replaces those powerblades and uses its own weapon profile.

31fb1c2e237d.name: Battle Focus
31fb1c2e237d.plain: Advancing doesn't stop this unit from shooting that turn, but if it does shoot after Advancing, then until the end of the phase its models can only attack with Assault or Pistol weapons they have, and the unit counts as having Remained Stationary when those attacks are resolved. In your Shooting phase, once this unit has finished its attacks, it can make a Battle Focus move unless it Fell Back or Advanced this turn: roll one D6, and each model in the unit can make a Normal Move of up to that many inches, as if it were your Movement phase. After a Battle Focus move, the unit can't embark within a TRANSPORT model when that move ends, and it can't declare a charge until the end of the turn. A unit that arrived as Reinforcements this turn can't make a Battle Focus move, and no unit can make more than one Battle Focus move in a turn. Note (Area Terrain): if any model in the unit wants to cross any part of an Area Terrain feature during a Battle Focus move, subtract 3" from how far the unit's models can move for that move (to a minimum of 0). The penalty still applies when no part of that Area Terrain feature is taller than 1", but it doesn't stack with other penalties that terrain feature imposes (such as the Difficult Ground terrain trait).

330c5728f201.name: Howling Skysword of Galaleth
330c5728f201.plain: Attacks made with this weapon always wound on a 2+.

33f07c2fc916.name: Poisoned Weapon
33f07c2fc916.plain: Many Drukhari weapons have the Poisoned Weapon ability, shown as 'Poisoned Weapon' followed by a value such as (4+) or (2+). When an attack with a poisoned weapon targets a unit that isn't a VEHICLE or TITANIC unit, an unmodified wound roll of that value always succeeds.

342171fde948.name: The Helm of Spite
342171fde948.plain: In your opponent's Psychic phase, the bearer can try to deny one psychic power as though it were a PSYKER. If it succeeds, the PSYKER that tried to manifest that power suffers Perils of the Warp.

3424fa76d68a.name: Twisted Animator
3424fa76d68a.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your <HAEMONCULUS COVEN> WRACK units within 3" of this WARLORD and add D3 destroyed models back to it. Those models may be set up within Engagement Range of enemy units already in Engagement Range of that unit.

34fab60cdae2.name: Master Nemesine
34fab60cdae2.plain: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by this WARLORD.

350ff0fec28e.name: Dark Harvest
350ff0fec28e.plain: When a unit with this Obsession finishes a charge move, you can roll one D6 for one enemy unit within Engagement Range: on a 4+, it suffers 1 mortal wound. That enemy unit can't be a VEHICLE unit.

35138819550e.name: Precise Killers
35138819550e.plain: For melee attacks made by models with this Obsession, the Blade Artists ability triggers on an unmodified roll of 5+ instead of 6.

360ccb65e916.name: Masterful Shots
360ccb65e916.plain: Targets of ranged attacks made by models with this attribute don't get the benefits of Light Cover against those attacks.

3804c6b458b9.name: The Nightmare Doll
3804c6b458b9.plain: Roll one D6 each time the bearer would lose a wound: on a 4+, that wound isn't lost.

38c7e535be13.name: Masters of Mutagens
38c7e535be13.plain: Melee attacks by models with this Obsession using a poisoned weapon (not a Relic) automatically wound on an unmodified hit roll of 6. This doesn't apply against VEHICLE or TITANIC units.

39f068c655f6.name: Garland of Spite
39f068c655f6.plain:
At the start of the Fight phase, halve the Attacks characteristic of one enemy model within Engagement Range of the bearer until the end of the phase. That model can't be a MONSTER or VEHICLE model.
The bearer's melee attacks hit the target automatically.

3b362f7bb33a.name: Acrobatic Display
3b362f7bb33a.plain: Models in a unit with this Obsession can pass horizontally through other models and terrain features when they pile in or consolidate. They can't end a move on top of another model or its base.

3bc15f82ec10.name: Slashing Impact
3bc15f82ec10.plain: When a model with this Obsession finishes a charge move, you can roll one D6 for one enemy unit within Engagement Range: on a 6, it suffers 1 mortal wound. That enemy unit can't be a VEHICLE unit.

3ccc5a513666.name: Insensible to Pain
3ccc5a513666.plain: Each time one of this unit's models would lose a wound, roll one D6; the wound isn't lost on a 5+.

3f38785f2997.name: Transfuser of Excruciation
3f38785f2997.plain: The bearer can make only one attack with this weapon each time it fights. If that attack hits, the target suffers 1 mortal wound and the attack sequence ends. Whenever a unit (other than a VEHICLE unit) takes a mortal wound from this weapon, its models get 1 subtracted from their Ballistic Skill, Weapon Skill and Strength characteristics.

3fad5802dc04.name: Treacherous Deceiver
3fad5802dc04.plain: Each unmodified 4+ saving throw for this WARLORD against a melee attack deals 1 mortal wound to the attacking unit once it has finished its attacks. The second part of the Cursed Blades' Obsession, Only the Strong Will Thrive, doesn't apply to this WARLORD.

41c9075d5c62.name: The Art of Pain
41c9075d5c62.plain: Units with this Obsession that have Power From Pain count the battle round as one higher for its effects while within Engagement Range of any enemy units.

41fa104d5e11.name: Iyanden: Enduring Resolve
41fa104d5e11.plain: Whenever this Warlord would lose a wound, roll one D6: on a 5+, it doesn't lose that wound.

4473edb7db29.name: Soul-Seeker
4473edb7db29.plain: This weapon has Poisoned Weapon (2+), and it can ignore the Look Out, Sir rule when you pick its targets. Targets don't get the benefits of cover against its attacks.

4668068713d6.name: Writ of the Living Muse (Aura)
4668068713d6.plain: Aura: while one of your KABAL OF THE BLACK HEART CORE units is within 6" of the bearer, re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by its models. If the bearer is a REALSPACE RAIDER unit, this also works for BLADES FOR HIRE units.

491db814be61.name: Warden of Souls
491db814be61.plain:
This WARLORD regains 1 lost wound at the start of your Command phase.
When this WARLORD is chosen to fight, if any enemy unit within its Engagement Range is below Starting Strength, add 1 to its Strength and Attacks characteristics until the end of the phase.

49ce28f8cc50.name: Sunstorm
49ce28f8cc50.plain: The bearer's Move characteristic is 20", and it has the Objective Secured ability. Only an ASURYANI BIKER model can have this Relic.

4a341fe69aa9.name: Wrath of the Dead
4a341fe69aa9.plain: WRAITH CONSTRUCT units with this attribute (but not AIRCRAFT units) can perform Heroic Interventions as if they were CHARACTER units.

4aabdd89e5b3.name: Parasite's Kiss
4aabdd89e5b3.plain: This weapon has Poisoned Weapon (2+), and the bearer regains 1 lost wound each time one of its attacks destroys an enemy model.

4b5f2e857ae5.name: Altansar 2. A Beacon of Light in the Darkness
4b5f2e857ae5.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your ALTANSAR units within 9" of this WARLORD: it can shoot during actions, and do actions after Advancing or Falling Back. Both last until your next Command phase starts. While performing an action, the unit can make ranged attacks without the action failing, and Advancing or Falling Back doesn't stop it performing actions that turn.

4c2bf09604a4.name: Cegorach's Rose
4c2bf09604a4.plain: You can re-roll the wound roll for attacks made with this weapon. The bearer gains the HARLEQUIN'S KISS keyword.

50b5da0444b9.name: Unparalleled Agility
50b5da0444b9.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll and the wound roll of every attack made against this WARLORD.

50c1a8d26953.name: Stimm Addict
50c1a8d26953.plain: Before the battle, when you roll for this WARLORD's Combat Drugs ability, roll 2 extra dice, re-rolling any results of 6 and any results already in effect. This WARLORD's Combat Drugs ability gives these benefits on top of any others.

51fd4a90b229.name: Mysterious Appearance
51fd4a90b229.plain: During deployment, when you set up this unit, you can place it anywhere on the battlefield more than 12" from the enemy deployment zone and from all enemy models. Whenever this unit is set up on the battlefield, its two Wraithbone Arches must be within 3" of each other. Once set up, each Wraithbone Arch counts as an Obstacle terrain feature with these terrain traits: Light Cover, Heavy Cover, Unstable Position and Inspiring (AELDARI).

53835ca385b2.name: Sudden Assault
53835ca385b2.plain: If every model in this unit has this ability, then during deployment you can set it up preparing a sudden assault instead of on the battlefield. In that case, in the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases it can be placed anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from every enemy model.

53a131931bfb.name: Hypex
53a131931bfb.plain: Models in this unit have 2" added to their Move characteristic.

54a8ddbb9c16.name: Psytronome of Iyanden
54a8ddbb9c16.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your IYANDEN SPIRIT HOST units within 9" of the bearer to get 1 extra attack per model until your next Command phase. If it is a WRAITHGUARD unit, it also gains the Battle Focus ability for that time. Only an IYANDEN model can have this Relic.

5651aae24b4e.name: Mask of Torment
5651aae24b4e.plain: At the start of the Morale phase, subtract 4 from the Leadership of models in one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer, until your next Command phase starts. Only a COTERIES OF THE HAEMONCULI model can have this Relic.

5795f74db421.name: Saviour Stone
5795f74db421.plain: When you make a Strands of Fate roll at the start of the battle round, you can raise or lower one of the dice by 1 (to a maximum of 6 or a minimum of 1). The bearer must be on the battlefield to do this.

57fed34529c3.name: Player of the Twilight
57fed34529c3.plain:
While this WARLORD is on the battlefield, you can roll one D6 per Command point either player spends on a Stratagem: each 6 gains you 1 Command point.
Rolling 4 or more dice on a Luck of the Laughing God roll while this WARLORD is on the battlefield also gains you 1 Command point.

5915d2f9683a.name: Saim-Hann: Wild Host
5915d2f9683a.plain: Units with this attribute can re-roll failed charge rolls. Falling Back doesn't stop them declaring a charge that turn.

594ebfcce250.name: Diabolical Soothsayer
594ebfcce250.plain: When this model is set up on the battlefield, choose to add 1 to either this WARLORD's Toughness and Wounds or its Move and Attacks characteristics. Both characteristics in the pair you choose go up by 1, for the rest of the battle.

5b030c45a47b.name: Expert Crafters
5b030c45a47b.plain: When a unit with this attribute shoots or fights, you can re-roll one of its wound rolls.

5d23963dd00c.name: The Lost Shroud
5d23963dd00c.plain:
Whenever an attack is allocated to the bearer:
- subtract 1 from its Damage characteristic (to a minimum of 1).
- if its unmodified Damage characteristic is 1, add 1 to any armour saving throw made against it.
Only a YNNARI model can have this Relic.

5d987d479f7f.name: Fear Incarnate
5d987d479f7f.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, you can try to stop one enemy unit within 9" of this WARLORD from performing actions and strip its Objective Secured ability. Roll 3D6: if the total is greater than that unit's Leadership characteristic, then until the start of your next Movement phase it can't perform actions (an action it is performing fails immediately) and it loses the Objective Secured ability.

5db1ee33467a.name: Power From Pain
5db1ee33467a.plain: Each effect below applies from the listed battle round onwards. Inured to Suffering (battle round 1+): models in this unit get a 6+ invulnerable save. Eager to Flay (battle round 2+): the unit is allowed to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. Flensing Fury (battle round 3+): add 1 to the hit roll of every melee attack made by this unit's models; also, if this unit has the VEHICLE or MONSTER keyword, it ignores the hit roll penalty for firing Heavy weapons at enemy units within its Engagement Range. Mantle of Agony (battle round 4+): models in this unit get a 5+ invulnerable save. Emboldened by Bloodshed (battle round 5+): the unit passes Morale tests automatically, and if its characteristics change as it takes damage, it counts as having twice its remaining wounds when you work out which characteristics apply.

5e3edad738f2.name: Agile Hunters (All-Consuming)
5e3edad738f2.plain:
Add 1 to the hit roll of attacks made by models with this Obsession against units that can FLY.
If a unit with this Obsession that has the Combat Drugs ability has the Hypex ability, it adds 4" to its Move characteristic instead of 3".

634e4c732e68.name: Cronescream
634e4c732e68.plain: Once per battle, when the Fight phase starts, you can try to inflict D3 mortal wounds on an enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer. Pick the unit and roll one D6: on a 2+, it suffers D3 mortal wounds, plus 1 more for each charge move the bearer has made during the battle. Only a Howling Banshee Exarch model can have this.

649364935b43.name: Swift Strikes
649364935b43.plain: When a unit with this attribute is chosen to shoot in your Shooting phase, it counts as having Remained Stationary for the rest of the phase. This doesn't apply if it Fell Back this turn.

64e1a891779d.name: The Spider's Bite
64e1a891779d.plain: An unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack with this weapon gives that attack a Damage characteristic of 3.

657543f51739.name: Webway Warriors
657543f51739.plain: In the turn a Reinforcement unit with this attribute is first set up on the battlefield, each unmodified hit roll of 6 for its attacks scores 1 extra hit.

65d1055321d4.name: Children of Khaine
65d1055321d4.plain: For melee attacks made by models with this attribute, an unmodified wound roll of 6 adds 1 to that attack's Damage characteristic.

6694c7e4ae10.name: Cegorach's Rose
6694c7e4ae10.plain: Only a HARLEQUINS model with a Harlequin's kiss can take this Relic, which replaces that Harlequin's kiss and uses its own weapon profile.

6730e1f281b6.name: Firesabre
6730e1f281b6.plain: Only an ASURYANI model with a Banshee blade or star glaive can take this Relic, which replaces that weapon and uses its own weapon profile.

67e721e11aa9.name: Serpentin
67e721e11aa9.plain: Models in this unit have their Weapon Skill characteristic improved by 1.

696640804eed.name: Shadowsting
696640804eed.plain: Only a Striking Scorpion Exarch model with a biting blade can take this Relic, which replaces that biting blade and uses its own weapon profile.

69edd26c6ed9.name: Savage Blades
69edd26c6ed9.plain: Improve the Armour Penetration of melee attacks by models with this attribute by 1 if their unit charged, was charged or performed a Heroic Intervention.

6bc73adab4d0.name: Torturous Efficiency
6bc73adab4d0.plain: For ranged attacks made by models with this Obsession, an unmodified wound roll of 6 improves that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.

6d6c63624524.name: Cult of Strife: The Spectacle of Murder
6d6c63624524.plain:
A unit with this Obsession that is within Engagement Range of any enemy units at the start of the Fight phase can fight first that phase.
When you declare a charge for a unit with this Obsession, add 1 to the charge roll if no other unit from your army is within Engagement Range of any of the charge's targets.

6e015533f283.name: Cult of the Cursed Blade: Only The Strong Will Survive
6e015533f283.plain:
Models with this Obsession add 1 to their Strength characteristic.
Each unmodified saving throw of 6 you make for a model with this Obsession against a melee attack deals 1 mortal wound to the attacking unit once it has finished making its attacks.

6e7debd3adee.name: Competitive Edge
6e7debd3adee.plain: When this WARLORD fights and directs all of its attacks at one enemy unit, it can make extra attacks against that unit once those attacks are resolved. It makes one extra attack for each of those attacks that never got to the inflict damage step of the attack sequence in that fight.

6eadcd4b5daf.name: Biel-Tan: Swordwind
6eadcd4b5daf.plain: Units with this attribute count Advance and Battle Focus move rolls of 1 or 2 as 3, and when such a unit shoots or fights, you can re-roll one of its hit rolls.

waive.142: page number reference ("pg 142") to where the Battle Focus rule is printed; the style guide forbids page references

702d65a8a4c0.name: Warp-Spawn Bane
702d65a8a4c0.plain: Attacks made with this weapon always wound on a 2+, and invulnerable saves are ignored for its attacks against enemy PSYKERS or DAEMONS.

7070c2caa908.name: The Armour of Misery
7070c2caa908.plain:
The bearer has these benefits:
- its Save characteristic is 3+.
- subtract 1 from the hit roll of each melee attack made against it.

712353e317f8.name: Biotargeting Orb (Aura)
712353e317f8.plain: Aura: within 6" of this model, friendly <HAEMONCULUS COVEN> CORE or <HAEMONCULUS COVEN> CHARACTER units add 1 to hit rolls against your chosen enemy unit. That is the enemy unit you picked at the start of the first battle round.

732db9b9ba13.name: Stratagem: Art of Poisonry
732db9b9ba13.plain: Until the end of the battle, any weapon a model in that unit has with the 'Poisoned Weapon (4+)' ability counts as having 'Poisoned Weapon (3+)' instead.

7404605b3264.name: Deadly Deceivers (All-Consuming)
7404605b3264.plain: Units with this Obsession can shoot in a turn in which they Fell Back. If they do, subtract 1 from the hit roll of their models' ranged attacks until the end of the turn.

755e23789b64.name: Hunters of Ancient Relics
755e23789b64.plain: Units with this attribute can shoot while performing an action without the action failing.

760e2e5e605b.name: War Shout
760e2e5e605b.plain: While this unit includes a Howling Banshee Exarch, subtract 1 from the hit roll of melee weapon attacks made against it.

76b6cc7cd914.name: Master Executioner
76b6cc7cd914.plain: You can re-roll the wound roll for any attack made by this WARLORD.

779a82b1c1f2.name: Mobile Raiders
779a82b1c1f2.plain: Models with this Obsession that can FLY have 2" added to their Move characteristic.

7a106c91411a.name: Famed Savagery
7a106c91411a.plain: This WARLORD's Strength and Attacks characteristics are both increased by 1.

7a1fbb614627.name: Talisman of Tionchar
7a1fbb614627.plain: If the bearer charged or Heroically Intervened this turn, its melee attacks have 1 more Strength and Damage, and 1 better Armour Penetration. Only a Saim-Hann model can have this Relic.

7a44d12220e6.name: Stratagem: Alliance of Agony
7a44d12220e6.plain: While mustering your army, if your WARLORD is a REALSPACE RAIDER ARCHON: one SUCCUBUS model and one HAEMONCULUS model from your army each get a Warlord Trait. Neither can be a named character, and each trait must be one that model can have. Each of those models counts as your WARLORD only for its own Warlord Trait. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be different (if you roll randomly, re-roll duplicates), and this Stratagem can't give a model two Warlord Traits. You can use this Stratagem only once.

7abe2755055d.name: Wild Rider
7abe2755055d.plain: Falling Back this turn doesn't stop your Warlord, or any of your WINDRIDER HOST units within 6" of your Warlord, from charging.

7afcbef39be5.name: The Suit of Hidden Knives
7afcbef39be5.plain: HARLEQUINS model only: when the Fight phase ends, the bearer can make 3 extra melee attacks, which can't target TITANIC units. For these attacks, every hit deals 1 mortal wound to the target and ends the attack sequence.

7b0da48c5c7b.name: Stinger-Engorger Pistol
7b0da48c5c7b.plain: Poisoned Weapon (its value is missing from the official text). When the bearer shoots, once its attacks are resolved: if any model in an enemy unit (not a VEHICLE unit) lost one or more wounds to those attacks, then until the end of the turn, every attack your models make against that enemy unit has its Armour Penetration characteristic improved by 1.

7ca953aa3f18.name: Deathly Perfectionist
7ca953aa3f18.plain: Every weapon this WARLORD has, other than Relics, gets 1 added to its Strength characteristic.

7eea90d4042c.name: Hail of Doom
7eea90d4042c.plain: Shuriken weapon attacks by models with this attribute wound automatically on an unmodified hit roll of 6, which also counts as an unmodified wound roll of 6. You can't pick this Far-flung Craftworld Attribute if you have picked any other Far-flung Craftworld Attribute, and if you pick it, you can't pick a second one.

waive.143: page reference (pg 143); page references are left out of plain texts

7efbd3bfa846.name: Altansar 1. Master of Rune-Warding
7efbd3bfa846.plain: In your opponent's Psychic phase, this WARLORD can try to deny one extra psychic power if it is a PSYKER; if not, it can try to deny one as if it were a PSYKER. You can re-roll this WARLORD's Deny the Witch tests.

waive.PASYKER: official typo for PSYKER; the plain text spells the keyword correctly (PSYKER is kept)

7f673f27826f.name: Quicksilver Fighter
7f673f27826f.plain: This WARLORD's Attacks characteristic goes up by 2.

80d4d885bfec.name: Player of the Light
80d4d885bfec.plain: This Warlord can make a Heroic Intervention when it is within 6" horizontally and 5" vertically of an enemy unit, rather than 3" horizontally and 5" vertically. Its Heroic Intervention moves can be up to 6", and all other Heroic Intervention rules still apply. Each time it fights in a turn in which it made a charge move or performed a Heroic Intervention, add 1 to its Strength and Attacks characteristics until that fight is resolved.

849355cea08f.name: Ulthwe: Fate Reader
849355cea08f.plain: After each Strands of Fate roll you make, if this Warlord is on the battlefield, you can keep one extra dice.

waive.143: page reference (pg 143); page references are left out of plain texts

869711a2d34d.name: 2: Walker of Many Paths
869711a2d34d.plain: Once per turn, you can re-roll a single hit roll, wound roll or damage roll made for this Warlord.

87109d783b3a.name: Wraith Host
87109d783b3a.plain: When choosing your army, use this Stratagem to make one Craftworld Detachment in your army a Wraith Host Specialist Detachment. Its WRAITH CONSTRUCTS gain the WRAITH HOST keyword.

8a43e81efdc1.name: Hyper-swift Reflexes
8a43e81efdc1.plain: Melee attacks made against this WARLORD always miss on an unmodified hit roll of 1-3, whatever abilities the attacking weapon or model has.

8acfe708cb39.name: Favour of Cegorach
8acfe708cb39.plain: Once per turn, after rolling one of this Warlord's hit rolls, wound rolls or saving throws, you can count the result as an unmodified 6.

8bc8e2432102.name: Dark Mirth
8bc8e2432102.plain: Units with this Obsession have Dark Mirth (Aura), which can deal mortal wounds to enemy units within 12" of them that are picked to move or charge. Each time an enemy unit within 12" of one of these units is picked to make a Normal Move, Advance, Fall Back or charge, roll a D6: on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

8c3b750c430b.name: Light: Blaze of Light
8c3b750c430b.plain: Attacks against a unit with this characterisation from a model more than 18" away fail on an unmodified hit roll of 1-3. This applies whatever abilities the attacking weapon or model has. If a unit with this characterisation Advances or makes a Normal Move during your Movement phase, then in your next Shooting phase it counts as having Remained Stationary. This doesn't apply while the unit is embarked within a Transport.

8e497127b459.name: Stratagem: Tolerated Ambition
8e497127b459.plain: While mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the DRUKHARI keyword: give one DRUKHARI CHARACTER model in your army (not a named character) a Warlord Trait. The trait must be one that model can have, and the model counts as your WARLORD only for that trait. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be different (if you roll randomly, re-roll duplicates), and this Stratagem can't be used to give one model two Warlord Traits. It can be used once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

8e79c9de4f1d.name: Khaine's Lance
8e79c9de4f1d.plain: Whenever the bearer finishes a charge move, pick one enemy unit within its Engagement Range and roll one D6: on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. On that 4+, it also isn't eligible to fight this phase until every eligible unit from your army has fought. Only a Shining Spear Exarch model can have this.

8ebd59651e1f.name: Revered By The Dead
8ebd59651e1f.plain: While your WRAITH HOST WRAITH CONSTRUCT units are within 6" of your Warlord, you can re-roll their charge rolls.

8f4a4001a8f0.name: Harlequin's Panoply
8f4a4001a8f0.plain: This unit's models have a 5+ invulnerable save. During any Normal Move, Advance, Fall Back or charge move this unit makes, its models can pass horizontally through models and terrain features (but they can't end the move on top of another model or its base). Subtract 1 from the hit roll of every melee attack made against this unit.

912bb94ffa95.name: Berserk Fugue (All-Consuming)
912bb94ffa95.plain: Models with this Obsession score 1 extra hit per unmodified melee hit roll of 6 if their unit charged, was charged or performed a Heroic Intervention this turn. If a mortal wound would make a model with this Obsession lose a wound, roll a D6: on a 5+, the wound isn't lost.

91958b604615.name: Soul Thirst
91958b604615.plain: This WARLORD's Attacks characteristic goes up by 1. Once per turn, when an enemy model within 6" of this WARLORD is destroyed, this model gets back 1 lost wound.

940064fa575a.name: Aegis of Eldanesh
940064fa575a.plain: AUTARCH model only: the bearer's Save characteristic is 2+, and every attack allocated to it has its Damage characteristic reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

9415836164fd.name: Masters of Concealment
9415836164fd.plain: A unit with this attribute gets the benefits of Light Cover against ranged attacks made by an attacker more than 12" away.

95b98fe6e5f6.name: Dancer's Edge
95b98fe6e5f6.plain: If an attack made with this weapon has an unmodified wound roll of 6, no invulnerable saving throw can be taken against it.

96a68420ede3.name: Kabal of the Flayed Skull: Slay From The Skies
96a68420ede3.plain: If a model with this Obsession can FLY or is embarked on a TRANSPORT unit that can FLY, targets of its ranged attacks get no benefit from Light Cover. VEHICLE units with this Obsession add 2" to their Move characteristic.

96ff4e91a8ed.name: Blood Dancer
96ff4e91a8ed.plain: When this WARLORD attacks in melee, each unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 2 extra hits.

97b5ef38b5f4.name: Kurnous' Bow
97b5ef38b5f4.plain: ASURYANI model with a shuriken pistol only: this Relic takes the place of its shuriken pistol and uses its own weapon profile.

989d66403d0a.name: The Avenging Blade
989d66403d0a.plain: Dire Avenger Exarch model with a diresword only: this Relic takes the place of the diresword and uses its own weapon profile.

98d2f0b523f3.name: Painbringer
98d2f0b523f3.plain: Models in this unit get 1 added to their Toughness characteristic.

9a0dd763bda8.name: Hungry for Flesh
9a0dd763bda8.plain: Charge rolls for units with this Obsession can be re-rolled.

9a11952d7176.name: Splinterblades
9a11952d7176.plain: When a model with this Obsession attacks with a melee weapon, each unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 1 extra hit.

9a8b0f1d6f7a.name: Traitor's Embrace
9a8b0f1d6f7a.plain: When a melee attack destroys the bearer, roll one D6: on a 2+, the attacking model's unit suffers D3+3 wounds once it has finished making its attacks.

9b395b5e38e8.name: Whirling Death
9b395b5e38e8.plain: When this WARLORD fights, after any pile-in moves you can set its Attacks characteristic to 3 plus the number of enemy models within 2" of it. This lasts until that fight is resolved.

9b91fad03877.name: Master Torturers
9b91fad03877.plain: When you pick a unit with this Obsession for the Torturer's Craft Stratagem, that Stratagem costs 1 fewer Command point.

waive.68: page reference (pg 68); page references are left out of plain texts

9f4124ed29ed.name: Children of Morai-Heg
9f4124ed29ed.plain: While its unit is below its Starting Strength, a model with this attribute adds 1 to the hit roll of every attack it makes.

a092b299820a.name: Alaitoc: Fieldcraft
a092b299820a.plain:
Units with this attribute:
- get the benefits of Light Cover against ranged attacks when the attacker is more than 12" away.
- if they are INFANTRY or BIKER units entirely on or within a terrain feature, also get the benefits of Dense Cover against ranged attacks when the attacker is more than 12" away.
- if they are INFANTRY units, can ignore any or all modifiers to their Move characteristic and to their Advance rolls.

a1e74f92a035.name: Dark: Dark Deeds
a1e74f92a035.plain: If a melee attack destroys a model with this characterisation, roll one D6: on a 4+, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound after it finishes its attacks. A unit can't suffer more than 6 mortal wounds per phase from this ability. Melee attacks made by models with this characterisation have their Armour Penetration characteristic improved by 1.

a298dd724849.name: Soul Bound
a298dd724849.plain: If a mortal wound would make a model with this Obsession lose a wound, roll a D6; that wound isn't lost on a 5+.

a3225e7633d8.name: The Spirit Stone of Anath'lan
a3225e7633d8.plain: BIEL-TAN PSYKER model only: the bearer knows one extra psychic power from its chosen discipline. Once per Psychic phase, you can re-roll one of its failed Psychic tests.

a4a56a63a003.name: Adrenalight
a4a56a63a003.plain: If this unit made a charge move or performed a Heroic Intervention this turn, each time it fights its models get 1 extra attack until that fight is resolved.

a4b7d5b542cb.name: Altansar 3. Weaver of the Blade Storm
a4b7d5b542cb.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your ALTANSAR CORE units within 9" of this WARLORD: its unmodified hit rolls of 6 with shuriken weapons wound automatically. This lasts until your next Command phase starts, and applies to every attack a model in that unit makes with a shuriken weapon.

a5fa0e125c70.name: The Vexator Mask
a5fa0e125c70.plain:
The bearer:
- can't be shot at with Overwatch by enemy units.
- lets you pick, at the start of the Fight phase, one enemy unit within 3" of it: that unit isn't eligible to fight this phase until every eligible unit from your army has fought.

a7c6d3db53b7.name: Faolchu's Wing
a7c6d3db53b7.plain: ASURYANI INFANTRY model only: the bearer has a 12" Move characteristic and the FLY keyword. When your Movement phase ends, choose one enemy unit that the bearer moved over during the phase and roll a D6: that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds on a 2+.

a7cd1228152a.name: Shrine Skull
a7cd1228152a.plain: Dark Reaper Exarch with a Reaper Launcher only: enemy units losing models to the bearer's attacks subtract 1 from Combat Attrition tests until the turn ends.

a879514e6b55.name: Merciless Razorkin
a879514e6b55.plain: When a model with this Obsession attacks with a splinter weapon, each unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 1 extra hit.

waive.116: page reference (pg 116); page references are left out of plain texts

ace9d571c0a9.name: Saim-Hann: Wild Rider Chieftain
ace9d571c0a9.plain: This Warlord's Attacks characteristic goes up by 1, and its Heroic Intervention distances are 6" instead of 3", both to qualify and to move. It can perform a Heroic Intervention when an enemy unit is within 6" horizontally and 5" vertically of it, rather than 3" horizontally and 5" vertically, and its Heroic Intervention moves can be up to 6" rather than 3". All other Heroic Intervention rules still apply.

ad17f06eda90.name: Seer Council (Farseer)
ad17f06eda90.plain: Add 1 to this FARSEER model's Psychic tests while it is within 6" of the selected WARLOCKS unit. While it is within 3" of that WARLOCKS unit, it can use the Look Out, Sir rule even if that unit has fewer than 3 models.

ad9f85ca0150.name: Soulthirst
ad9f85ca0150.plain: In a turn in which this Warlord charged, was charged or made a Heroic Intervention, add 1 to its Attacks characteristic. Also, each time this Warlord destroys an enemy model in the Fight phase, it regains 1 lost wound.

b3af1bfdee9d.name: Shuriken Weapons
b3af1bfdee9d.plain: When an attack made with a shuriken weapon gets an unmodified wound roll of 6, that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic is improved by 2. Many Aeldari weapons are shuriken weapons: each has an ability that says 'Shuriken'.

b4f7647eba8f.name: 2. Schemer Supreme
b4f7647eba8f.plain: While this WARLORD is on the battlefield: whenever your opponent spends a Command Point on a Stratagem, you can roll one D6, gaining 1 Command Point on a 5+.

b50787b98962.name: The Avenging Blade
b50787b98962.plain: When an attack made with this weapon wounds the target, it deals 1 mortal wound to the target and the attack sequence ends.

b673147e30b0.name: Alchemical Maestro
b673147e30b0.plain: Once per battle, when this model is destroyed, it can come back: roll one D6 at the end of the phase, and on a 2+, set it up again with D3 wounds remaining. If you choose to roll, skip any rules that its destruction triggers. It must be set up as close as possible to where it was destroyed, and not within Engagement Range of any enemy models.

b7695c10c930.name: The Phoenix Gem
b7695c10c930.plain: ASURYANI model only: when the bearer is first destroyed, roll a D6: on a 2+, it comes back at the end of the phase with D3 wounds left. Until then, keep it to one side. Set it back up as close as possible to where it was, not within Engagement Range of any enemy models.

b9aab1c67939.name: Firesabre
b9aab1c67939.plain: For attacks made with this weapon, an unmodified hit roll of 6 also deals a mortal wound to the target, on top of any normal damage.

bb1d54f73ef2.name: Biotargeting Orb
bb1d54f73ef2.plain: For the rest of the battle, the bearer gains the ability below, which works against one enemy unit you pick at the start of the first battle round. That unit must be on the battlefield and can't be a VEHICLE unit. Only a COTERIES OF THE HAEMONCULI model can have this Relic.

bb8580c7f229.name: Master Regenerist
bb8580c7f229.plain: When this WARLORD uses its Fleshcraft ability, the model it targets gets back up to 3 lost wounds, not D3.

bdfc12aac1a9.name: Faolchu's Talon
bdfc12aac1a9.plain: SOARING SPITE model only: a SOARING SPITE TRANSPORT carrying the wearer can move an extra 6" in the Movement phase. If a SOARING SPITE TRANSPORT is destroyed while the wearer is inside, skip the rolls for whether disembarking models are slain and whether the transport explodes: none of the disembarking models are slain and the transport doesn't explode.

bf0f5041d926.name: Webway Strike
bf0f5041d926.plain: Whenever an AELDARI unit from your army arrives from Strategic Reserves, you can choose to place it anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of both Wraithbone Arches of one of your WEBWAY GATE units. If you do, it may be set up within 9" of enemy models. If it ends up within Engagement Range of any enemy models this way, it is treated as having made a charge move this turn (no Overwatch attacks can be made against it), and until the end of the turn it can make melee attacks against any enemy unit it is within Engagement Range of, even though it didn't declare a charge this turn.

c06e05ac4b75.name: Cult of the Red Grief: The Speed of The Kill
c06e05ac4b75.plain: Units with this Obsession can re-roll their charge rolls, and add 2 to their Advance rolls.

c54803c659d6.name: Favoured of Khaine
c54803c659d6.plain: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save, can't lose more than 3 wounds in any one phase, and can never be given a Relic or a Warlord Trait.

c70cf3a5e8bb.name: Dragon's Fury (Shrine Relic)
c70cf3a5e8bb.plain: Fire Dragon Exarch model only: whenever the bearer's unit is chosen as a charge target, subtract 2 from that charge roll.

c8003352e380.name: Lord of Rebirth
c8003352e380.plain: This Warlord regains up to 1 lost wound at the start of each battle round, and each time it would lose a wound, roll one D6: the wound isn't lost on a 5+.

c84d4a87ebc9.name: Morvaines's Agoniser
c84d4a87ebc9.plain: Poisoned Weapon (4+). Each time the bearer fights, once all its attacks are resolved, pick one enemy unit that was hit by this weapon's attacks (you can't pick a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit). That unit can't Fall Back until your next turn starts.

c8ff1721cc0e.name: Test of Skill
c8ff1721cc0e.plain: Melee attacks made by models with this Obsession against MONSTER or VEHICLE units add 1 to their wound rolls.

ca5e1971c61b.name: Master Artisan
ca5e1971c61b.plain: This WARLORD's Toughness and Wounds characteristics each go up by 1.

cb0f6a2f95bb.name: Favoured of Ynnead
cb0f6a2f95bb.plain: This Warlord's pile-in and consolidation moves can be up to 6" rather than up to 3".

cb67b5fdd7bf.name: Dark Lotus Toxin
cb67b5fdd7bf.plain: Every melee weapon the bearer has, other than Relics, gets 1 added to its Strength and Damage characteristics.

cc9adabb4b06.name: Mobile Fighters
cc9adabb4b06.plain: If its unit disembarked from a TRANSPORT model this turn, a model with this attribute adds 1 to the wound roll of every attack it makes.

cdc16ac8b90d.name: Consummate Weaponmaster
cdc16ac8b90d.plain: Every melee weapon this WARLORD has, other than Relics, gets 1 added to its Damage characteristic.

ce6e71d6c0ac.name: The Dark Creed: Distillers of Fear
ce6e71d6c0ac.plain: Units with this Obsession have Aura of Terror (Aura): enemy units within 6" of them subtract 1 from their Leadership and their Combat Attrition tests. Units with this Obsession also add 1 to the hit roll of each melee attack they make against a unit whose Leadership characteristic is equal to or lower than the attacking unit's.

cee34e12097c.name: The Starmist Raiment
cee34e12097c.plain: HARLEQUINS model only: hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks against the bearer can't be re-rolled. Once per battle, in your Command phase, you may have the bearer mimic Aelos, giving it a 3+ invulnerable save until your next Command phase starts.

d19883a562a5.name: Splintermind
d19883a562a5.plain: Models in this unit have their Ballistic Skill and Leadership characteristics improved by 1.

d2052c5d8499.name: Kurnous' Bow
d2052c5d8499.plain: Shuriken; also, any attack made with this weapon that wounds the target deals 1 mortal wound to it and ends the attack sequence.

d264fdbb5b4e.name: 1. Calculating Gaze (Aura)
d264fdbb5b4e.plain: Aura: while one of your <HAEMONCULUS COVEN> CORE units is within 6" of this WARLORD, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

d2f402e24fa5.name: Hatred Eternal
d2f402e24fa5.plain: You can re-roll both the hit roll and the wound roll for every attack this WARLORD makes.

d301cd3b2b1f.name: 1: Ambush of Blades
d301cd3b2b1f.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your <CRAFTWORLD> CORE or <CRAFTWORLD> CHARACTER units within 9" of this Warlord to improve the AP of its melee attacks by 1. This lasts until your next Command phase starts, and applies to the Armour Penetration characteristic of every melee attack made by a model in that unit.

d3ae92a88905.name: Headstrong
d3ae92a88905.plain: Units with this attribute can re-roll their Advance rolls and charge rolls.

d4d5334f4069.name: Diviners of Fate
d4d5334f4069.plain: Whenever you make a Strands of Fate roll, you can roll one extra D6, as long as all the units in your army have this attribute. Units that are AGENTS OF THE AELDARI, ANHRATHE or UNALIGNED are ignored for this.

waive.143: page reference (pg 143); page references are left out of plain texts

d52e6f894ca2.name: Altansar: Grim Survivors
d52e6f894ca2.plain: Melee attacks by models with this attribute have AP improved by 1 if their unit was charged, made a charge move or performed a Heroic Intervention this turn. Add 1 to Combat Attrition tests taken for units with this attribute.

d678958a46a4.name: Vengeful
d678958a46a4.plain: When a model with this attribute attacks with a melee weapon, each unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 1 extra hit.

d746d151a681.name: Toxin Crafters (All-Consuming)
d746d151a681.plain: When a model with this Obsession attacks with a poisoned weapon, an unmodified hit roll of 6 gives that attack Poisoned Weapon (2+) instead. These attacks also re-roll a wound roll of 1.

d771c2bf79a2.name: The Ghosthelm of Alishazier
d771c2bf79a2.plain: ULTHWE PSYKER model only: the bearer knows one extra psychic power from the Runes of Fortune discipline. When a Psychic test is taken for it, an unmodified result of 9+ means that psychic power or psychic action can't be denied.

waive.123: page reference (pg 123); page references are left out of plain texts

d8e18aa4325a.name: Experimental Creations
d8e18aa4325a.plain: Models with this Obsession get 1 added to their Strength characteristic.

daedeb35eccd.name: The Phial Bouquet
daedeb35eccd.plain: At the start of each battle round, roll one D6: until that battle round ends, the bearer gets the matching effect from the Combat Drugs ability table. The effect can be one the bearer already has, and it stacks with it.

db5e569aaf96.name: Advanced Positions
db5e569aaf96.plain: During deployment, if every model in this unit has this ability, you can place it anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from the enemy deployment zone and from all enemy models.

dddd6bf66e7e.name: Towering Arrogance
dddd6bf66e7e.plain: Whenever this WARLORD would lose a wound to a mortal wound, roll one D6; on a 5+, it doesn't lose that wound.

ddf0f5188fe3.name: 3: Falcon's Swiftness
ddf0f5188fe3.plain: This Warlord's Move characteristic goes up by 2, and it can ignore the effects of the Difficult Ground terrain trait. When it makes a Battle Focus move, don't roll a dice; it can move up to 6" instead.

df76be5ec929.name: Scarlet Epicurean
df76be5ec929.plain: Every attack allocated to this WARLORD has its Damage characteristic reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

e1cac4316617.name: Kabal of the Poisoned Tongue: The Serpent's Kiss
e1cac4316617.plain: When a model with this Obsession attacks with a poisoned weapon, improve that weapon's Poisoned Weapon ability by 1, to a maximum of 2+. For example, Poisoned Weapon (4+) becomes Poisoned Weapon (3+). Until the end of the turn, subtract 1 from Combat Attrition tests for any enemy unit that has had models destroyed by poisoned-weapon attacks from models with this Obsession.

e21c13681163.name: Warding Runes
e21c13681163.plain: Models with this attribute get a 6+ invulnerable save. Whenever one of them would lose a wound to a mortal wound, roll one D6; on a 5+, the wound isn't lost.

e242bd2a0ccb.name: The Triptych Whip
e242bd2a0ccb.plain: Poisoned Weapon (2+), and each time the bearer is chosen to fight, its Attacks characteristic goes up by 3 until the end of the phase.

e271af2c66eb.name: Artists of the Flesh (All-Consuming)
e271af2c66eb.plain: Attacks with Strength below 8 allocated to a model with this Obsession (not a VEHICLE model) have their Damage characteristic reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

e35c18538fbe.name: Emblem of the Broken Chain
e35c18538fbe.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your ALTANSAR CORE units within 6" of the bearer: it can re-roll Advance and charge rolls until your next Command phase.

e37e0e231d90.name: Children of the Open Skies
e37e0e231d90.plain: Models with this attribute add 1" to their Move characteristic, or 2" instead of 1" if they can FLY. When an Advance roll is made for a unit with this attribute, a roll of 1-2 counts as a 3.

e496c8b80aba.name: Shard of Anaris
e496c8b80aba.plain: ASURYANI model with a Banshee Blade or Star Glaive only: this Relic takes the place of that Banshee Blade or Star Glaive and uses its own weapon profile.

e59b1fee645a.name: The Ghoulmask
e59b1fee645a.plain: DARK model only: the bearer can try to deny one psychic power in your opponent's Psychic phase, just as a PSYKER could. If it is a PSYKER, it can try to deny one more psychic power than usual in each of your opponent's Psychic phases. The bearer also has the Hideous Form (Aura) ability: an enemy unit within 3" of this model loses the Objective Secured ability.

e5c39e49a489.name: Stratagem: Rule Through Fear
e5c39e49a489.plain: This model's aura abilities get 3" more range. Whenever it uses an ability other than an aura ability in your Command phase, that ability gets 3" more range for that use.

e878dff96957.name: Twisted Hunters
e878dff96957.plain: Attacks made by models with this Obsession against CHARACTER units add 1 to their hit rolls.

e935be08b983.name: Trophy Takers
e935be08b983.plain: Enemy units that had any models destroyed by melee attacks from a unit with this Obsession roll one extra D6 for Morale tests and discard the lowest result.

ebbd636b861e.name: The Laughing God's Eye
ebbd636b861e.plain: While one of your HARLEQUINS units is within 6" of the bearer, roll one D6 for each wound its models would lose to a mortal wound: on a 5+, it isn't lost. This is the bearer's aura ability, The Laughing God's Eye, and only a HARLEQUINS model can have this Relic.

ec9e20bfe40d.name: Precision Blows
ec9e20bfe40d.plain: When a melee attack by this WARLORD has an unmodified hit roll of 6, the target unit suffers mortal wounds equal to the weapon's Damage characteristic. The attack sequence then ends.

ee11b7cd10f0.name: Ynnari: Strength from Death
ee11b7cd10f0.plain: At the start of the Fight phase, any unit with this attribute that is within Engagement Range of enemy units can fight first that phase. While its unit is below its Starting Strength, a model with this attribute adds 1 to the hit roll of every attack it makes.

ee2b27f6e0a8.name: Raiding Forces - CP Refund
ee2b27f6e0a8.plain: If all the Detachments in your army are DRUKHARI Patrol Detachments, each of them has a Command Cost of 0CP.

f07915b2cde3.name: Void mine
f07915b2cde3.plain: Once per battle, after the bearer makes a Normal Move or Advances in your Movement phase, each unit within 6" of a point it crossed can suffer D6 mortal wounds. You can pick a point on the battlefield that the bearer moved across, then roll one D6 for every unit within 6" of it, subtracting 1 for units with the CHARACTER keyword (excluding VEHICLE or MONSTER units); on a 4+, the unit rolled for suffers D6 mortal wounds.

f15a74027a09.name: Biel-Tan: Natural Leader
f15a74027a09.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your BIEL-TAN CORE units within 6" of this Warlord: until the end of the turn, you can re-roll its hit rolls. This applies to every attack made by a model in that unit.

f20dfeb694d9.name: Shiftshroud of Alanssair
f20dfeb694d9.plain: ALAITOC INFANTRY model only: while it has the benefits of cover, the bearer can't be picked as a ranged attack's target, with one exception. It can be picked if the attacker is within 12" and the bearer is the closest eligible target for that attack.

f3eb6aa21b6c.name: The Twilight Fang
f3eb6aa21b6c.plain: When the bearer fights, add the number of the current battle round to its Attacks characteristic until that fight is resolved.

f562089e465d.name: Midnight's Chime
f562089e465d.plain: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, you can have MIDNIGHT SORROW units add 1 to their Attacks while within 6" of the bearer, until the phase ends.

f67fa6f14c7c.name: 4: Fate's Messenger
f67fa6f14c7c.plain: Once per turn, when this Warlord fails a saving throw, you can make the Damage characteristic of that attack 0.

f830f29eaf7a.name: Webway Raiders
f830f29eaf7a.plain: When you use the Webway Portal Stratagem and pick any units with this Obsession for it, that Stratagem costs 1 fewer Command point.

waive.69: page reference (pg 69); page references are left out of plain texts

f9e8b4726ae2.name: Webway Travellers
f9e8b4726ae2.plain: If this unit is part of your army and the Strategic Reserves rule is being used, the Command Point cost of putting AELDARI units into Strategic Reserves can be halved (round fractions down). This doesn't stack with similar abilities, such as Prince of Corsairs.

fa22153f0f70.name: Labyrinthine Cunning
fa22153f0f70.plain: While this WARLORD is on the battlefield, you can roll one D6 per Command Point either player spends on a Stratagem: each 6 gains you one Command Point.

fb5171358032.name: Rising Crescendo
fb5171358032.plain: Advancing doesn't stop this unit from declaring a charge that turn. Falling Back doesn't stop it from shooting and from declaring a charge that turn.

fc76df3a0c80.name: Blade Artists
fc76df3a0c80.plain: When a model in this unit attacks with a melee weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 6 improves that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.

fe3d0e77509a.name: Shadow Stone
fe3d0e77509a.plain: LIGHT SHADOWSEER model only: the bearer's aura abilities get 3" more range, up to a maximum of 9". When the bearer successfully manifests a psychic power from the Phantasmancy discipline, that power's effects get 3" more range.

ff2dc69ae01f.name: Iyanden: Stoic Endurance
ff2dc69ae01f.plain: Add 1 to Combat Attrition tests for units with this attribute, and worsen by 1 the Armour Penetration of attacks with AP -1 or -2 allocated to their models. For example, AP -2 becomes AP -1.
